summary: Operator's 2026 pages confirm $75/night (up to 4 people), ReserveAmerica booking, 98 sites, 30-amp full hookups on sites 1-12 and 17-35; NEW season May 1-Oct 12, store, laundry, dump, no WiFi. No residency limit stated anywhere (books on ReserveAmerica, one price for all). Note: dropped the wrong '$55 in 2026' and the restated sites/hookups/booking/season.
flags: Ownership weakly supported: kornscampground.com never names the Town of Wallkill; the only official tie found is a 2016 NY Senate release saying the Town Board voted to buy the property, and ReserveAmerica lists the park under its private-campground contract (PRCG). If it is actually private, $75/night is over the US$50 gate with no gateway within 40 km (nearest Newark 90 km) and the family has not stayed there.
Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says '39 acres of wooded land on the Shawangunk Kill River'; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
Minor: ReserveAmerica's structured data for the park carries telephone 207-573-1844 (a Maine number); the operator's own number is 845-394-0117, which the entry has.
